## Change and evidence

Describe the resulting change, source file/node IDs or frontend references, observation date and approval status. Explain removals, mode/alias changes and remaining gaps.

## Review

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Generated outputs and bundled references match canonical sources.
- [ ] Human-authored guidance has explicit design review; proposals remain labelled.
- [ ] Credentials, confidential assets and redistribution permissions have been reviewed.
- [ ] Required design and engineering reviewers are assigned; no automatic merge requested.

## Validation limits

State any unavailable live Figma, frontend, browser, accessibility or human checks.
